summary: Arabic critics and reader discussion, Persian book culture, Russian personal reading and Mexican reception history add new perspectives. The Persian guide’s historical inconsistencies are flagged; only its interpretive evidence is used.
next: More literary scholarship and underrepresented regions; avoid weak commercial summaries.

sources.note: Persian reading guide interprets the owl symbolism and fragmented narrator through isolation and the erosion of selfhood.

sources.title: Rulfo y sus críticos
